subject: ENGLISH
title: Common or Proper? · M01 D06
introduction: A common noun names a general person, place, animal, or thing. A proper noun names a specific one and begins with a capital letter.

vocabulary.definition: A word that names a person, place, or thing.
A living thing that can move and needs food.
A name for any person, place, or thing.
